scope: Original-position overlay; all character attributes, hyperlink targets, independent underline colour, and soft/hard line boundaries across continuous resize

observations.method: source inspection plus retained resize regressions
observations.limitation: PageManager retrieves inactive buffers at current visible size using ResizeTraditional; shrinking can discard stored rows and columns before restoration.
Copies OutputCell character/attribute data and image blocks; does not copy source row wrap metadata. Cell preservation alone does not establish lossless reflow.

observations.method: own-marker RGB/glyph probe and source inspection
observations.limitation: Only a subset of terminal attributes is available; the implementation provides no hyperlink children/targets or independent underline colour. Own-marker RGB success is not complete-history support.
Feature-gated 16-bit checksum; RGB maps to default legacy colours, and only legacy DEC attributes contribute. It cannot establish equality of full attributes, hyperlinks or line boundaries.

observations.method: source inspection; native round trip not executed
observations.limitation: Serialization includes hyperlink URI and some styles, but the underline-colour branch switches on foreground colour type rather than underline colour type. For a default foreground and RGB underline it emits the underline default reset. The mapping also does not emit every CharacterAttributes flag. This is not an accepted complete-state snapshot.

observations.method: existing product implementation and failed RGB/Unicode resize regressions
observations.limitation: UTF-16 cell and legacy WORD attributes do not represent the required complete character and attribute state. This remains the fallback after resizing, and is not an accepted solution.

conclusion: No investigated interface has passed the required lossless resize round trip. This is a limitation of the investigated approaches, not proof that every possible architecture is impossible.
rejected_changes_remain_rejected: large host rewrite without separate authorization
existing_user_acceptance: Ordinary Esc RGB/character recovery for fixed 2fe57b9 package only; not resize or all-attribute acceptance
